pure-announcement.rationale: It is a directory README, not a launch post — it documents an ongoing marketplace structure rather than announcing a release.

duplicate.rationale: No existing concept in this corpus covers Claude Code plugin distribution.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Claims are directly checkable against the repository itself.

durability.rationale: Install commands, directory layout and submission process are product mechanics that will churn; the one durable element — the platform explicitly disclaiming verification of third-party plugin behaviour — is a single caveat, not the substance of the note.

actionability.rationale: Actionable only inside one product (install/submit steps); it transfers no practice a reader outside Claude Code could apply.

atomicity.rationale: One subject: the official plugin directory and how to use it.
